observables.key_carry: Public image[3][6] kind=5, original source-public; not hidden env.carrying
observables.key_pickup: before not carrying key, after carrying key
observables.key_drop: before carrying key, after no key
observables.repeat: Any repeated exact public image/direction/mission before hash within its own source episode, NOT across episodes
observables.door_contact: Front source-public pixel image[3][5] object=4 while key visibly carried
observables.forward_with_key: original action=2 when source-public before image[3][6] carries key
observables.productive_chain: pickup -> source-public key retained while forward action -> source-public door-front with key -> source door state change -> original positive reward; report stages separately, do not fabricate paths

hypotheses.h1: Wingless DK10 has more unique original views than original DK9 on same three seeds, but substantial pick/drop cycling; key pickup and drop counted separately.
hypotheses.h2: Yggdrasil R14 explores more unique views than R13 but no key-carry forward action on these original seeds.
hypotheses.h3: Neither new native reaches a source-public door directly in front while carrying key; neither opens source door or earns original goal reward.

fairness_caveat: MG07 source calls Go choose with manually constructed `original.objective(owner,before)` even though original public image also supplied; Yggdrasil R13/R14 and conventional receive only native public observation/control object. Public-derived but externally preprocessed task-stage advice is a distinct manual information channel and must be reported, not silently treated as equal internal policy.

next_intervention.target: native self-discovered state persistence and action-effect sequences, plus ablation without human-specified stage objective
next_intervention.controls: old native policy, equal-information conventional episodic learner, same FIT and source budget, random baseline
next_intervention.metric: time in key-carried state, forward with retained key, door contact/open, real goal reward, distinct/repeated views, full CPU/RSS including Go subprocess, cold retest and unfamiliar seeds
